samples.text: What has to be true: nothing about seats — local-first costs less at any seat coverage, even with no Copilot seats at all, because the staff time on the work is on the corporate bill either way. The floor carries the work at 16.9% of the enrolled laptops in year 1 and 29.6% in year 5.

The estate's dual-map decision gate. Its positive/negative maps, the non-compensating (max) aggregator, the TOA hard gate, law-as-evidence (never the verdict), PASS/BLOCK/PENDING, the escort weighting at q_E,0 = 0.7 (a reproducible baseline, not a universal constant), and the audit-receipt schema draw on Gary W. Floyd, Lumiea Systems Research Division — ThunderStruck Service LLC — "From GEP Stabilization to Dual-Map Ethical Reasoning," Derivation v0.2

Serve render-harness.html and call window.render(text, {fontPx, maxWidthPx}) in the browser to get {width, height, dataUrl} — wrap the dataUrl's base64 payload in an image content block and pass it to count-tokens.mjs for the real image-token count. Full step-by-step is in findings.json's own reproduce field.

konomify's basis gate runs the check on every build: no declaration, a hand-edited or stale map (older than the law, or than 180 days), or a declared Article 5 practice, and the build does not pass. This repository carries its own: compliance.html. The page's R7 section runs the same kernel in the browser.

"We'll automate it with a cloud API instead": That is the route where customer data leaves the building: a processor contract with the model vendor (GDPR Art 28), transfer assessments (Chapter V), a per-token bill — and the Copilot seats are still on every desk. Five years on that route: £3,595,271 — still £2,025,205 more than local-first.

Each deployment decision is a dual-map case built from fallfloor's receipted evidence and this design's published policy thresholds: a positive map (what the evidence supports) beside a negative map (the evidence-supported ways it fails). One severe, evidence-backed failure BLOCKs; an unmeasured risk holds at PENDING. Each verdict is sealed into a self-verifying receipt; the page re-verifies them and shows a forged verdict being rejected.

18 tests. The two pure functions behind the renderer — tokensForImage (Anthropic's documented formula, pinned against a real-world example: Anthropic's own 1092×1092 max-recommended-edge figure) and layoutPixels (the character-wrapping math) — are gated. The empirical parts (the real API calls, the vision read) are not gated, and this repo doesn't pretend otherwise; they're documented honestly in findings.json instead.

Go/no-go method: Gary W. Floyd, Lumiea Systems Research Division — ThunderStruck Service LLC — "From GEP Stabilization to Dual-Map Ethical Reasoning," Derivation v0.2. Evidence: fallfloor, on Banking77 (PolyAI, CC BY 4.0), SMS Spam Collection (Almeida and Gómez Hidalgo, CC BY 4.0) and CLINC150 (Larson et al., CC BY 3.0).

comply.mjs (mutation-gated) is the compliance map every estate build ships. A build declares what it does in compliance.decl.json: does it run an AI system (none / narrow / generative), who built it (provider or deployer), where it runs (local / cloud / SaaS), does it touch personal data, talk to the public, generate content, make significant decisions about people, fall under Annex III or Article 5, is its output used in the EU.
